choices.text: Read back through the last few days.

nodes.text: Vane's ledger lies open at the table's far edge, out of the wine's reach. Columns of holdings, valuations, arrears. A working man's book, kept beautifully.

Kelder toll, a seizure of undeclared goods. The Mistfall, nineteen years of arrears totalled in a hand that did not hesitate. Then — between the eleventh and the thirteenth — a stub. A page has been torn out close to the binding, recently and not carefully.
The stub is where it was. Whatever the twelfth held, it is not in this room.
You close the book on the dead man's handwriting.
